abstract.p: The present disclosure provides compositions and methods for isolating HLA-peptides from cells. The present disclosure provides a universal platform and methods for profiling the HLA-peptidome, enabling identification of endogenously presented HLA-peptides from cell lines expressing any possible class I or II construct.
